name: Boldva (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Boldva: a crowned blue shield with a yellow bunch of grapes, a sickle and a white wavy stripe, above a scroll inscribed BOLDVA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Boldva arms with crown and scroll
